changes.evidence: The Collector never holds the Tesseract in the MCU. In the Thor: The Dark World mid-credits scene Sif and Volstagg give him the Aether (Reality Stone) precisely because the Tesseract is already in Asgard (Odin's Vault); he later nearly gets the Orb (Power Stone) in Guardians of the Galaxy. The proposed hint keeps the pointer to the app's Collection page (as in the how_to) without the false claim.
